rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for expressing an unfavorable opinion about an idea, action, or plan.

example.english: I disapprove of you doing it this way.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zaan3 sing4 nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6

rows.note: Use this when you actively oppose or condemn something as wrong or inappropriate.

example.english: I disapprove of smoking in the park.
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 deoi3 hai2 gung1 jyun4 kap1 jin1

rows.note: Use this specifically when an authority refuses to give official approval or permission.

example.english: The principal chose to disapprove of our request to leave school early.
example.traditional: 校長唔批准我哋提早放學。
example.jyutping: haau6 zoeng2 m4 pai1 zeon2 ngo5 dei6 tai4 zou2 fong3 hok6
